planPostureBody: Plan mode never executes the statement it wrote, on any engine — production included. Its one reach is the schema capture that grounds it: metadata only, no data rows, and it is where the inventory in Run details came from. On PostgreSQL and SQLite that capture is itself a catalog read; on every other engine it asks the provider to describe its own schema.
